Converter AI 1.0.0 — Initial release

- Convert and export video files (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, up to 500MB) to 1080p MP4 format via cloud GPU processing.

- Supports common video workflows: quick edits, batch processing, and iterative editing with session state.
- Handles keyword-based routing for uploads, exports, credits, and status.
